responsibility: This generated companion file attaches GCC manual URL suffix metadata to the option records defined in mips-tables.opt. In the MIPS backend’s option-description subsystem, it exists so the .opt processing machinery can associate documentation links with the generated -march=, -mtune=, and -mips enumerated CPU/ISA values that come from mips-cpus.def via genopt.sh, even when a particular build ends up with no per-option URL entries.
